subject: food-technology
title: Lifestyle & Special Diets
welcome_lead: Vegetarian, vegan, allergies — different ways to eat.
meta_desc: KS3 food: special diets, allergies, lifestyle choices.
final_note: Everyone's plate is different — respect that.

concepts.def: Eats no animal products at all.
Body reacts badly to a food.
Body struggles to digest a food.

walkthroughs.body_html: Vegetarians avoid meat and fish but may eat dairy and eggs. Vegans avoid all animal products. Both need to watch protein (beans, tofu) and B12 (often supplemented).
An allergy (nuts, eggs, shellfish) can cause a fast, severe reaction — sometimes life-threatening. An intolerance (lactose) causes stomach trouble.
Halal (Muslim) and Kosher (Jewish) follow specific rules on what is allowed and how it's prepared. Many Hindus are vegetarian. Always check labels and ask.
